answer: Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 48 identities means 48 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Because the quartz pair is tracked in the relic ledger, the dune audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Full reward requires answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 54%. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
